sentences.en: MAN: As I said earlier, there is I think at Rexford an excellent combination of physical and geographical advantages - as well as having a rural setting and still being close to central London, something that will certainly be of interest to you is that Rexford is just 5 minutes from London Airport.
sentences.zh: MAN: 正如我之前所说，雷克斯福德大学拥有极为优越的自然与地理条件——它地处乡村环境，同时又紧邻伦敦市中心；此外，对各位而言尤为有利的一点是，雷克斯福德距离伦敦机场仅需5分钟车程。

sentences.en: At Rexford we /012 have a strong research capability.
sentences.zh: 在雷克斯福德，我们拥有强大的科研实力。

sentences.en: We came 7th out of 101 universities in last year's research assessment, carried out by a government body and did particularly well in your particular subjects, engineering and science.
sentences.zh: 在去年由政府机构开展的科研评估中，我们在全英101所大学中排名第七，尤其在各位所专注的工程学与科学领域表现尤为突出。

sentences.en: Actually we got a top research grade of five for engineering, geography and computer sciences.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的工程学、地理学及计算机科学均获得了科研评级的最高等级——五级。

sentences.en: One further point and I know from talking to you individually that a number of you may be looking for some experience in industry after the course - is that all our science and engineering research departments have unusually close relationships with industry in the area.
sentences.zh: 再补充一点：我知道通过与各位的个别交流了解到，部分同学可能希望在课程结束后获得一些行业实践经验——在此我要说明，我校所有科学与工程类科研部门均与本地产业界保持着异常紧密的合作关系。

sentences.en: Anyway that's enough 011/012 sales talk from me . . .
sentences.zh: 好了，我的这番‘推销式’介绍就到此为止……

sentences.en: I'll just take a sip of this coffee that's just arrived, thank you, and then I'll say something about what actually happens when you apply.
sentences.zh: 我先喝一口刚送来的咖啡，谢谢；接着，我将为大家简要说明申请流程的具体操作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Now if you do decide to make an application, what you do is send it directly to me in my department.
sentences.zh: 若您最终决定提出申请，您需直接将申请材料寄送至我所在的院系。

sentences.en: I will then immediately send confirmation and the application process begins.
sentences.zh: 我收到后会立即向您发送确认函，申请流程随即正式启动。

sentences.en: Er . . .

I'd like to say at this point that you shouldn't worry if this process doesn't work all that quickly - I mean occasionally there are postal problems, but most often the hold-up is caused by references - the people you give as referees, shall we say, take their time to reply.
sentences.zh: 在此我想特别说明：若整个流程进展不够迅速，请各位不必担忧——我的意思是，偶尔会出现邮递问题，但大多数情况下延误源于推荐信环节：即您所指定的推荐人往往需要较长时间才予以回复。

sentences.en: Anyway, it's absolutely normal for this process to take three to four months.
sentences.zh: 总之，整个流程耗时三至四个月实属正常现象。

sentences.en: What I do in this period is keep in touch with you and reassure you that things are moving along.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我会持续与您保持联系，并向您确认各项事务正稳步推进。

sentences.en: One of the ways we've devised to help you decide about applying as well as later when you've been accepted .
sentences.zh: 为协助各位在申请前做出决策，以及在获录取后进一步了解情况，

sentences.en: hopefully.
sentences.zh: 希望如此。

sentences.en: is to put you in contact with, if possible, a student from your own country who is at present studying with us.
sentences.zh: 我们特设一项安排：尽可能为您对接一位目前在我校就读的、来自您本国的在校生。

sentences.en: What you can do is phone them up - we will, of course, liaise between you - and discuss your concerns with them.
sentences.zh: 您可主动致电他们——当然，我们会全程居中协调联络——并与之交流您所关心的问题。

sentences.en: That way you can get an objective opinion of what you can expect if you come to live and study at Rexford - not only the academic atmosphere but important details like what the leisure www.TopSage.com Tapescripts 17 5 4 19 facilities are like and whether the English weather and food are really as awful as everybody says!
sentences.zh: 借此方式，您便可获得关于赴雷克斯福德学习与生活的客观评价：不仅涵盖学术氛围，还包括诸多重要细节，例如休闲设施状况，以及英国天气与饮食是否真如众人所言那般糟糕！

sentences.en: lop>age.com If you decide you can face it, the contact can also help you just before you leave, with tips on what to pack and that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 若您最终决定迎难而上，该联络人亦可在您启程前提供实用建议，例如行李打包清单等事宜。

sentences.en: At the moment I think we've got two second-year students and one postgraduate from this country.
sentences.zh: 目前，我认为我们有两位本科二年级学生及一位来自贵国的研究生。

sentences.en: Now to move on to the other concerns you expressed earlier.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们转向各位先前提出的其他关切事项。

sentences.en: At a UK university • as I'm sure you know you will be in an environment where independent learning is the norm, which takes most students a while to adjust to, and at a time when you will be separated from your normal surroundings and, in most cases, your family.
sentences.zh: 在英国高校——我相信各位对此已有所了解——自主学习是普遍要求，绝大多数学生都需要一段时间来适应；而此时，您将远离熟悉的生活环境，且在多数情况下与家人分离。

sentences.en: This can be a difficult time.
sentences.zh: 这一阶段可能颇具挑战性。

sentences.en: But remember that something like 25% of our student body are international students like yourselves, and that there are several organisations in the university and city whose main purpose is to offer help and ensure that your time with us is enjoyable and useful.
sentences.zh: 但请谨记：我校学生群体中约25%为国际学生，与各位情况相同；此外，校内及本市还设有多个组织，其核心宗旨正是提供支持与帮助，确保各位在我校的学习生活充实而愉快。

sentences.en: One or two of you touched on the subject of accommodation earlier.
sentences.zh: 先前有几位同学曾提及住宿问题。

sentences.en: So I'll
sentences.zh: 因此，我将

sentences.en: just add a few points: it is the University's policy to give priority in the allocation of residence places to three categories, and those are: visiting students, exchange students and new postgraduate students.
sentences.zh: 仅作几点补充说明：学校在分配宿舍名额时，优先保障三类学生，即：访问学生、交换生及新入学的研究生。

sentences.en: However, demand exceeds supply, so there is still a need to put your name down early for campus accommodation, particularly if your family is accompanying you.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于需求远超供给，您仍需尽早登记申请校内住宿，尤其是当您的家人将随行同住时。

sentences.en: This means that the earlier you decide whether you want to study with us . . . and so get the procedure moving, the better it will be for everybody.
sentences.zh: 这意味着：您越早确定是否选择我校就读，从而启动相关程序，对各方而言都将更为有利。

sentences.en: Yes?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: What if you would prefer to live outside the university?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 如果您更倾向于在校外居住呢？

sentences.en: MAN: If you're planning to live off-campus, you've got to sort things out even earlier.
sentences.zh: MAN: 若您计划在校外租房，则需更早着手安排。

sentences.en: As with everything in short supply, the good accommodation gets snapped up months before the - beginning of term - in other words if you're starting in October you need to be thinking about it in June or at the very latest July.
sentences.zh: 正如所有供不应求的资源一样，优质房源往往在学期开始数月前便已被抢订一空——换言之，若您将于十月入学，则需在六月即开始考虑，最迟不得晚于七月。

sentences.en: So you do need to think very carefully about what you need, how much you can afford to pay, well in advance.
sentences.zh: 因此，您务必提前审慎思考自身实际需求及可承受的租金水平。

sentences.en: What you can't do is leave it until a few days before the start of term.
sentences.zh: 您绝不可拖延至开学前几天才着手处理。

sentences.en: The agencies in town are pretty good - it's just a matter of contacting them in good time.
sentences.zh: 本市房产中介的服务质量相当可靠，关键在于您须尽早主动联系。

sentences.en: Of course, we have a full-time accommodation officer available to help all students.
sentences.zh: 当然，我校配备有专职住宿事务专员，可为全体学生提供协助。

sentences.en: She'll get in touch with you when you're accepted - she's got plenty of contacts in the town and will deal with the agencies on your behalf.
sentences.zh: 待您获正式录取后，她将主动与您取得联系——她与本市多家中介机构均有长期合作，可代您处理全部相关事宜。

sentences.en: One or two of you asked me earlier about your level of spoken English.
sentences.zh: 先前有几位同学曾向我咨询过您的口语英语水平问题。

sentences.en: Obviously most of you have already achieved a lot - wish I could speak your language half as well.
sentences.zh: 显然，你们中的大多数人已经取得了很大的成就——真希望我能像你们一样把你们的语言说得那么好。

sentences.en: Having said that though, I'm afraid the lecturers will make little or no allowance for the presence of non-native speakers in the audience.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我恐怕讲师们不会因为听众中有非母语者而给予多少、甚至根本不会给予任何特殊照顾。

sentences.en: So anything you can do to improve your spoken English - even beyond the pretty high levels most of you have already reached - will help make your stay with us that bit more fun for you.
sentences.zh: 因此，你们为提高英语口语水平所做的一切努力——哪怕是在你们大多数人已达到的相当高的水平之上再进一步——都将有助于让你们在我们这里的时光变得更加愉快。

sentences.en: Some extra practice before you arrive is worth more than.
sentences.zh: 抵达前进行一些额外练习，其价值远超……

sentences.en: for example private lessons afterwards, when you won't really have time.
sentences.zh: 例如，抵达后参加私人辅导课程，但那时你们实际上将没有多少时间。

sentences.en: Oh ... and one last thing before I invite further
sentences.zh: 哦……在我邀请大家进一步提问之前，最后还有一件事……

sentences.en: questions: it's very important that you . ..
sentences.zh: 问题：非常重要的是，你们……

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com 7.300
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 7.300
